mapper.select: SELECT ats.id AS sessionId, ats.course_id AS courseId, c.name AS courseName, ats.teacher_id AS teacherId, u.real_name AS teacherName, ats.session_date AS sessionDate, ats.duration AS duration, ats.status AS status FROM attendance_session ats INNER JOIN course c ON ats.course_id = c.id INNER JOIN sys_user u ON ats.teacher_id = u.id WHERE ats.id = #{sessionId}

SELECT ar.id AS recordId, ar.student_id AS studentId, su.username AS studentNo, su.real_name AS studentName, oc.name AS className, ar.status AS status, ar.checkin_time AS checkinTime FROM attendance_record ar INNER JOIN sys_user su ON ar.student_id = su.id LEFT JOIN org_class oc ON su.class_id = oc.id WHERE ar.session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY CASE ar.status WHEN 1 THEN 0 WHEN 5 THEN 1 WHEN 2 THEN 2 WHEN 3 THEN 3 WHEN 0 THEN 4 WHEN 4 THEN 5 ELSE 6 END, ar.checkin_time IS NULL, ar.checkin_time ASC

SELECT ar.id AS recordId, ar.session_id AS sessionId, ats.course_id AS courseId, c.name AS courseName, c.code AS courseCode, ats.session_date AS sessionDate, ar.checkin_time AS checkinTime, ar.status AS status FROM attendance_record ar INNER JOIN attendance_session ats ON ar.session_id = ats.id INNER JOIN course c ON ats.course_id = c.id WHERE ar.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY ats.session_date DESC, ar.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS present, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 'leave', SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS absent, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS truant, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS manual FROM attendance_record WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
SELECT student_id FROM selection_record WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND status = 1
